displayName: LSASS memory dump with a dump tool
description: A process dump tool was pointed at LSASS.

queryCondition.queryText: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName in~ ('procdump.exe','procdump64.exe') | where ProcessCommandLine has 'lsass'

alertTemplate.title: LSASS memory dump with a dump tool
alertTemplate.description: A process dump tool targeted LSASS.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Check who ran the tool and whether credentials were exposed.
